info.title: spread-comparison-tools
info.description: Cross-venue execution quality / spread comparison API

get.description: Process liveness — always 200 while serving (including degraded).

Data-freshness probe: 200 when engine data is ok, else 503.

Distinguishes "process up" from "serving only stale rows" (WHI-819).
External uptime monitors should hit this endpoint in addition to
``GET /health``.
Fan out to adapters; one asset, one or many notional tiers (WHI-843).

get.description:
Static venue registry + whether an adapter is currently registered.

Venues disabled in ``config/venues.yaml`` are omitted entirely (WHI-840) so
they do not appear as quote targets and consume no fan-out budget.
All validated venue fee schedules (WHI-812; frontend contract for WHI-813).

Return tradeable stables and catalogued assets for pair construction.

Discovery only — does not change ``POST /simulate`` validation. Clients
should not hardcode USDC/USDT; this list is the SSOT (WHI-833).

post.description: Fan out a free-form pair trade to adapters; rank by expected output.

422.description: Pair validation or request body error. Pair failures use SimulatePairErrorDetail ({message, reason}); pydantic body validation uses the default HTTPValidationError shape.

429.description: Per-client rate limit for on-demand simulation

503.description: Reference mid unavailable or simulator not initialized

FeeBreakdown.title: FeeBreakdown
FeeBreakdown.description: Per-quote fee components (WHI-799 §5.4). bps fields are authoritative.

FeeSchedule.title: FeeSchedule
FeeSchedule.description: Venue-level fee table shape (WHI-799 §5.5). Numbers filled by WHI-812.

FeeTier.title: FeeTier
FeeTier.description: One fee tier inside a FeeSchedule (WHI-799 §5.5).

status.title: Status
status.description: Always 'ok' when the process is serving.

adapters_expected.title: Adapters Expected
adapters_expected.description: Enabled adapters that should be started (excludes config-disabled).

degraded.title: Degraded
degraded.description: True when at least one enabled adapter is not initialized.

unavailable_venues.title: Unavailable Venues
unavailable_venues.description: Enabled venue slugs that failed or have not completed startup.

engine.description: Real-time engine signals (streams, sweeps, mid, alerts).

HealthResponse.title: HealthResponse
HealthResponse.description:
Liveness payload for ``GET /health`` (WHI-840 / WHI-819).

Always HTTP 200 while the process is serving — including when degraded or
when engine data is stale. Load balancers must not kill a process that is
still serving the majority of venues. Use ``GET /health/data`` for the
data-freshness probe that fails on stale-only serving.

Quote.title: Quote
Quote.description: Single venue quote at a notional size (WHI-799 §6.2).

QuotesResponse.title: QuotesResponse
QuotesResponse.description:
``GET /quotes`` payload.

Single-tier calls set ``notional_usd`` to that tier and ``notionals`` to a
one-element list. Multi-tier calls (``?notionals=…``) return every tier's
pairs under one ``snapshot_id`` / mid; ``notional_usd`` is the first
(sorted) tier for back-compat (WHI-843).

ReferenceMid.title: ReferenceMid
ReferenceMid.description: Snapshot-scoped reference mid shared by all venues (WHI-799 §3.5).

SimulatePairErrorDetail.title: SimulatePairErrorDetail
SimulatePairErrorDetail.description: Structured 422 body for pair validation failures (WHI-814 / WHI-815 client).

stables.title: Stables
stables.description: Tradeable USD stablecoin symbols accepted as a pair leg (no USD).

assets.title: Assets
assets.description: Catalogued non-stable logical assets for the other leg.

SimulatePairsResponse.title: SimulatePairsResponse
SimulatePairsResponse.description:
``GET /simulate/pairs`` — valid legs for building a simulate pair (WHI-833).

Contract for WHI-815: clients form pairs as (one of ``stables``) ×
(one of ``assets``), either direction. Exactly one leg must be a tradeable
stable; ``USD`` is never listed (peg-only, not tradeable).

sell_asset.title: Sell Asset
sell_asset.description: Asset the user sells, e.g. SOL or USDC

buy_asset.title: Buy Asset
buy_asset.description: Asset the user receives, e.g. USDC or SOL

amount.title: Amount
amount.description: Quantity of sell_asset (free-form; not snapped to notional tiers)

venues.title: Venues
venues.description: Optional venue slug filter; default = all registered adapters

instrument_type.title: Instrument Type
instrument_type.description: Override adapter default instrument type when the class supports it

SimulateRequest.title: SimulateRequest
SimulateRequest.description: ``POST /simulate`` body: sell/buy assets and amount in sell-asset units.

side.title: Side
side.description: Adapter side: sell when selling non-stable, buy otherwise

SimulateRowResponse.title: SimulateRowResponse
SimulateRowResponse.description: One ranked venue row in the simulate response.

SizeQuotePair.title: SizeQuotePair
SizeQuotePair.description: Buy+sell pair at one size for one venue (WHI-799 §6.4; aggregator synthesizes).

TopOfBook.title: TopOfBook
TopOfBook.description: Orderbook top-of-book snapshot (WHI-799 §6.3). AMM/Prop never produce this.
